body.cap: CIT CEO Seung Jeong (left) and team presenting their transparent display product at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Advanced materials startup CIT(CEO Seung Jeong) gained attention at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, which runs until January 10. CIT’s groundbreaking transparent antenna, Dolphin, an Honoree of the CES 2025 Innovation Awards in the Vehicle Tech & Advanced Mobility category, drew significant interest from global industry leaders, as did its transparent display technology.

The transparent antenna ‘Dolphin,’ unveiled for the first time at CES 2025, supports six frequency bands from the L-band to the K-band, with coverage extending up to 20GHz. Designed for autonomous vehicles, Dolphin facilitates vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) and vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication, aligning with the demands of the software-defined vehicle (SDV) era by delivering high-speed data transmission.

Dolphin’s ultra-thin copper circuit, less than 10 nanometers thick, achieves 90% transparency while being 1,000 times thinner than conventional antennas. This remarkable combination of aesthetics and performance captivated CES attendees. Furthermore, Dolphin employs an eco-friendly manufacturing process utilizing recycled wires, reducing its carbon footprint to 1/1000th of traditional products.

An automotive executive who visited the CIT booth remarked, “Dolphin’s technology dramatically increases design flexibility in autonomous vehicle development and promises to elevate communication performance to new heights.”

body.cap: CIT’s ‘Dolphin’ transparent antenna supports up to 20GHz across six frequency bands. The product won the CES 2025 Innovation Award. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: CIT also showcased its transparent display technology, leveraging ultra-thin copper circuits to deliver near-invisible transparency. This innovation attracted interest from professionals in commercial facilities and public transportation.
One exhibition planner stated, “Transparent displays offer a groundbreaking solution to seamlessly blend content with the environment, making them highly versatile for various applications.”

CIT’s booth became a hub for representatives from global automakers, smart building developers, and public transport operators eager to experience the Dolphin antenna and transparent displays firsthand. According to CIT, the strong reception reflects the market’s appreciation for their innovative, sustainable solutions.
CIT CEO Seung Jeong commented, “Dolphin is just the beginning. With technologies like transparent and stretchable displays, CIT aims to be at the forefront of global innovation.”

body.cap: Prototypes featuring CIT’s ultra-thin copper circuit technology on display at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Founded in 2023, CIT has achieved remarkable milestones within two years, including winning the CES Innovation Award, the FLY ASIA 2024 Advanced Manufacturing Award, and a gold medal at the Seoul International Invention Fair.

Focusing on transparent antennas and display technology, CIT is accelerating commercialization through partnerships with global companies and establishing itself as a leader in next-generation communication and electronic substrate materials.

CIT’s technologies showcased at CES 2025 demonstrate applications across automotive and smart urban infrastructure industries, revealing new possibilities for futuristic communication and electronic material technologies.
